name: Crossfade
doc: Blends across 2 to 4 image inputs by `amount` (0 = in0, 1 = the last connected one; in between, the two neighbours), with blend modes. Bind amount to a signal; only the one or two inputs in play render.

mode.doc: how each next input comes in over the one before

snap.doc: within this of an input, show it alone (and skip its neighbour)
